task.semantic_objective: Move the eraser along the observed upright whiteboard. Measure the stroke and eraser-board contact. Paint or ink removal is unobserved.
task.source_semantics: researcher interpretation of source images, rigid trajectory and hand/object surfaces; exact source action labels unavailable
task.interpretation: measured object rigid path; no inferred electronic, liquid, deformation or ink outcome

release_source.measure: near 3 mm and clear above 7 mm from pairwise triangle distance; final min(150 ms,20% duration) with at least 80% clear for each required target-hand
release_source.decision: source does not establish withdrawal at the end of a place

functional_reference.evaluation: Compute movement of the fixed target material point relative to the actual partner, projected onto the frozen axis. Compare ordered source progress and episode-end signed displacement. When required, measure active compressive tool-partner contact in the corresponding source window; never infer food deformation, ink removal or applied force from video.
functional_reference.force_window_rule: for each required interval, active solver normal force >0 on tool-partner in at least half the interval; retain each interval independently
functional_reference.ordered_displacement_rule: evaluate with frozen task.progress at the same source clock, 10 mm resolvable legs, native replay duration weighted; endpoint must lie within the source motion tolerance

gravity_evidence: device-specific source-world up prior, Aria +Z and Quest +Y; no per-clip gravity field in HOT3D Clips
